question: To which deity and in which direction must the offering be presented with this formula?
premises: The verse prescribes giving an offering with this formula.
Kṣetrapāla is named as the recipient of the offering.
The western direction is specified as the location for this offering.
inference: Therefore, one should give the offering with this formula to Kṣetrapāla in the west.
plain_english: Then, with this formula, one should give the offering to Kṣetrapāla in the west.
